card.name: First word of drug interaction subsections
card.fires_on: The first word (or its first pieces) of the sentence that opens a label subsection, right after the subsection heading. Typical openers are co-administration, discontinuation, hypersensitivity and prolongation.

modes.label: Co-administration openers
modes.description: Opening of a drug interaction subsection, such as Co-administration or Concomitant administration of a drug.
modes.example: 7.1 Aminoglycosides and Other Agents Interfering with Neuromuscular Transmission Co-admin<<istration>> of MYOBLOC and aminog

modes.label: Reaction term openers
modes.description: Partway through a repeated opening term such as Hypersensitivity, Discontinuation or Prolongation, which restates the subsection heading.

card.plain: It fires on the first word of a label subsection that repeats its heading, often about drug interactions or hypersensitivity.
